column1: # recheck-captures.tsv — committed body capture per recheck URL (round 56, corpus/recheck-replay.py)
# One row per URL a knowledge entry's `recheck:` clock fetches. Body bytes only (curl -o; no
# response headers are stored — QM72); bytes and sha256 are of the stored body. fetched is the
# capture date; http_status the final status curl reported. url equals the clock's URL
# byte-for-byte and appears in the id's registry row. Replacing a capture is a reviewed commit.
